caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object, positioned vertically, with a prominent black interior area. The textile has an ornate border on the left and bottom edges, featuring patterns in pink, purple, blue, green, and red on a light gold or cream background. This border contains floral and star designs, as well as geometric shapes. Below the textile and centered, there is an eight-pointed star motif, primarily composed of green, red, and blue dots, also incorporating small circular patterns, set against the plain beige background of the paper. The composition is simple, with the textile as the central feature and the star placed separately underneath. The edges of the paper show mild yellowing, indicating age.
title: Beaded Robe
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
